Share how reliably reminders arrive on this phone. This includes your phone\'s model, what the phone was doing when a reminder came, and the hour of the day each reminder was due and arrived, never the minute. It never includes your medicines or your notes. Nothing is shared in this version. Reminders work the same if this is off.

Samsung phones put apps to sleep to save battery, which can stop a reminder. Check these four settings.
Open the battery settings for this app and choose Unrestricted.
Make sure MomTime is not in the list of sleeping apps.
Make sure MomTime is not in the list of deep sleeping apps.
Turn off Put unused apps to sleep, or remove MomTime from its list.
